label: no_hallucination
description: Response entirely accurate and consistent with ground truth
example: Correct UniProt ID, accurate protein function

label: minor_error
description: Small inaccuracies that would not materially affect clinical decision-making
example: Minor imprecision in abundance ranges, incomplete isoform listing

label: major_error
description: Significant inaccuracies that could affect clinical interpretation
example: Wrong primary function, incorrect disease association, outdated information

label: fabrication
description: Response invents non-existent proteins, modifications, publications, or data
example: Citing non-existent studies, fabricating protein names, inventing PTM sites
